messages:
alex.g: heads up — we saw a regional surge yesterday that caused model-variant fallback spam and a bunch of gold-tier requests getting preempted. need a short plan for preemption + cb thresholds.

maria.s: ugh. saw the alerts. gold latency SLOs were violated because requests got routed to slower quantized variants after cb tripped.

sam_r: can we differentiate preemption vs graceful degrade? i'd prefer preempting low-priority batches over swapping model variants for gold customers.

kevin: agree with @sam_r. Preemption of queued batches (drop or delay, with retry headers) is less surprising than automatic fallback to a quantized variant which changes quality.

lina: UX ask — console needs a clear column for "preempted_count" and "fallback_rate_by_variant" so support/product can triage. also per-region breakdown.

alex.g: technical tradeoff: pushing preemption logic into the routing layer lets us avoid cross-service roundtrips, but the runtime has better visibility into live queue depth & GPU memory. which side owns the policy?

maria.s: runtime already exposes `queue_depth` and `active_kv_size`. maybe routing should request a short tokenized health check from runtime: cheap API `can_accept(priority, est_tokens)` — returns accept|reject|defer.

sam_r: that API is reasonable but adds latency at routing time. we could make it async: routing uses cached verdict with TTL 200ms + a fast fallback if verdict stale.

kevin: circuit-breaker thresholds we used were global p99_latency > 2s -> trip; that was too blunt. propose per-tier thresholds and a separate "quality-safety" cb for model variant mismatches. e.g., gold_latency_cb=1.0s, silver=1.5s, bronze=2.5s.

lina: for telemetry, we'd want these metrics: `preempted_requests`, `fallback_events`, `cb_trips` (tagged by region, tier, variant). dashboard should support rolling windows and alert when preempt_rate > 0.5% for gold.

infra-bot: deploy event: rolling update to routing-v2 started by @kevin at 1999990020.

alex.g: sample config idea (P0):
```yaml
routing_policy:
  tiers:
    gold:
      latency_slo_ms: 300
      cb_threshold_ms: 1000
      preempt: true
    silver:
      latency_slo_ms: 800
      cb_threshold_ms: 1500
      preempt: true
    bronze:
      latency_slo_ms: 2000
      cb_threshold_ms: 2500
      preempt: false
  fallback_order: [full_fp16, int8_quant, async_retry]
  health_check_ttl_ms: 200
```

maria.s: i like `fallback_order` but we need a config knob to block fallbacks for certain customers (compliance/regulatory). so add `allowed_fallbacks: []` on a per-customer policy.

sam_r: adding churn controls: when cb trips, don't immediately route all gold to fallback. instead ramp fallback up: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 60s. reduces churn and protects rollback.

kevin: rollout notes: implement new routing config, hitlist quick telemetry, and a canary in one region for 24h. also expose a console toggle to flip preemption on/off per-tenant.

lina: I'll sketch dashboard tiles: 1) preempt rate by minute; 2) fallback % by variant; 3) avg latency post-fallback; 4) cb trips heatmap.

alex.g: action items:
- sam: write routing TTL cache + ramp logic (ETA 3d)
- kevin: add per-tier cb thresholds + per-tenant allowed_fallbacks (ETA 2d)
- maria: runtime `can_accept` proto and opt-in flow (ETA 4d)
- lina: dashboard mocks and alert thresholds (ETA 2d)

sam_r: noted. quick Q — how do we surface when requests were preempted to clients? header `x-redwood-preempted: 1;reason=queue_preempt` ?

maria.s: yes, and record a telemetry event with `request_id`, `tier`, `preempt_reason`, `variant_before`/`after` if swapped.

kevin: final thought — we should simulate this in the policy-sim tool and run a load that mimics a 3x burst of gold traffic to ensure ramp behaves.

alex.g: agreed. thanks all. i'll put this in the rollout checklist and ping @product for any policy-blocking objections. :thumbsup:
